name: Being Fat
overview: Scripture addresses the concept of fat both in dietary laws and spiritual metaphor. God provided plants and fruits for food (Genesis 1:29), yet commanded Israel to abstain from eating fat and blood as a perpetual statute (Leviticus 3:17; 7:23). Spiritually, fatness symbolizes complacency and turning away from God, as seen in Deuteronomy 32:15 where Israel's 'waxing fat' is linked to forsaking their Creator. Job 15:27 also uses fatness figuratively to describe a covering that hides the face, emphasizing the spiritual implications of excess and self-indulgence.
